# Unified Computer Use API

These setup details are internal. User-facing progress updates should be less technical in nature. Never mention `Node REPL`, `node_repl`, `REPL`, JavaScript sessions, module exports, reading documentation, or loading instructions unless a user is asking for that exact information.

If setup or recovery is needed, describe it naturally as initializing or retrying the connection.
Do not inspect or patch installed packages.

## `node_repl`

## Calling `node_repl`

Use the preconfigured `node_repl` js tool for every CUA action.
Do not use shell commands, CDP, AppleScript, or another browser/computer tool.
Call `tools.mcp__node_repl__js(...)` directly through `functions.exec` even when the tool is deferred.

```js
const result = await tools.mcp__node_repl__js({
  code: `nodeRepl.write("ready");`,
});
for (const item of result.content ?? []) {
  if (item.type === "image") image(item);
  else if (item.text) text(item.text);
}
```

Never use `functions.view_image` for a Sky screenshot.
Use `nodeRepl.emitImage(...)` and forward the returned image block unchanged.

## `cua.initialize`

Always initialize the runtime first to discover available desktop apps and browsers.

`state` contains `apps` and `browsers` with tabs (newest-first).

```js
globalThis.cua ??= (await import("@oai/cua")).cua;
globalThis.cua_init = await globalThis.cua.initialize();
nodeRepl.write(JSON.stringify(globalThis.cua_init));
```
Browser task + discovered browser: use `cua.browsers`
Desktop app task: use `cua.computer`

If the same `cua.initialize()` error occurs twice, report it and stop.

## `cua.computer`

Desktop automation tasks that require screenshots, clicking, dragging, moving the pointer, pressing keys, typing text, scrolling, etc.

You must read the documentation for your platform before taking further actions

- [linux](./computer-linux.md)
- [macos](./computer-macos.md)
- [windows](./computer-windows.md)


## `cua.browsers`

Browser automation tasks such as inspecting pages, navigating, testing local apps, clicking, typing, taking screenshots, and reading visible page state.

```js
browser = await cua.browsers.get("cdp");
nodeRepl.write(await browser.documentation());
```

Use only the documented `cua.browsers.*` API to interact directly with the browser.
References to Playwright mean the in-skill `tab.playwright` API after browser-client setup.

## `cua.documentation`

```js
help = await cua.documentation.get("bootstrap-troubleshooting");
nodeRepl.write(help);
```

Get specific documentation by name

- `bootstrap-troubleshooting`: read when initialize succeeds but browser discovery or selection fails
